newsitem.title: USA: Finish Line Inc Q1 May 31 sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Finish Line Inc Q1 May 31 sales rise.

text.p: Finish Line Inc, a footwear retailer, said Thursday that comporable-store sales for the 13 weeks ended May 31 rose one percent from a year earlier. Overall sales were $87.5 million, up from $70.3 million a year ago.
Comparable net footwear sales increased about two percent, while comparable net sales for activewear/accessories declined about two percent, the company said.
Because of a shift in the company's reporting calendar, the 1997 reporting period had 91 days, while the 1996 period had 92 days, the company said.

"Men's and youth footwear categories were sluggish for most of the first quarter although showing some improvement in May," Alan Cohen, president and chief executive officer, said in a news release. "Weakness in activewear resulted from poor sales in licensed products and slower sales in men's tops and shorts. Some new footwear introductions did not perform as well as anticipated for the quarter, and we experienced price resistance to some of the higher priced footwear."
Product margins improved because of lower inventory per square foot, the company said.
Finish Line shares were off 1/8 to 12-5/8 at midday.
